create_reaction_by_id: create a Reaction object by specifying a reaction ID from the reaction database
create_reaction_by_string: create a Reaction object by specifying a reaction string to look up in the database
create_reaction_by_type: create a Reaction object by specifying a reaction type like dissociation or transfer
create_reaction_random: create a Reaction object by randomly selecting a reaction from the database
get_desorption_mapping: get the atom index mapping for a desorption reaction using get_desorption_mapping
